name: The Longmeadow Shops
summary: The Longmeadow Shops is a neighborhood shopping center serving the affluent community of Longmeadow, Massachusetts. Located on Bliss Road, this convenient retail destination offers a mix of quality retailers, services, and dining options with extended operating hours.
demographics: The Longmeadow Shops serves an affluent suburban demographic in Longmeadow, Massachusetts, one of the most prosperous communities in the Springfield metropolitan area. The primary trade area consists of upper-middle-class families with household incomes significantly above the state median, typically ranging from $100,000 to $200,000+. The visitor base skews toward educated professionals aged 35-65 with children, as well as retirees who value convenience and quality. Shopping patterns reflect a preference for specialty retailers, professional services, and dining options that cater to discerning tastes and busy lifestyles.
description: The Longmeadow Shops is a well-established neighborhood shopping center located at 724 Bliss Road in the heart of Longmeadow, Massachusetts, one of the Pioneer Valley's most desirable residential communities. This convenient retail destination serves the affluent Longmeadow area and surrounding communities with a carefully curated mix of retailers, services, and dining options. The center operates with extended hours from 6:00 AM to 11:00 PM, providing flexibility for busy professionals and families throughout the day. Situated in a prime location along Bliss Road, The Longmeadow Shops benefits from strong visibility and easy accessibility for local residents seeking quality shopping and services close to home. The center's tenant mix reflects the sophisticated preferences of the Longmeadow community, offering a blend of everyday conveniences and specialty retailers that cater to the area's discerning clientele.
